trials.rule_before_measurement: Baseline: accepted specialized exact FP16 dequant/native FP16-input FP32-accumulation XMX,expert batch8. Candidates: row-symmetric INT8 weights/activations,INT32 XMX;mode2 adds one quantized activation residual in both projections,sharing INT8 weights (weight quantization error remains). Complete chain includes dequant,every activation/weight quantization and repack,rescale,original SwiGLU. No persistent repacked-weight cache;8physical copies of each real expert blob,one real expert per format. GU16/22/29/42,down42,N2560,F640,T1/6/8/16/40/64/128/256;synthetic normal and 1-in-256 16x outlier activations. CPU INT32 dot oracle incl residual,zero row,max-finite FP16,nonfinite rejection flag,padded tails,output/scratch guards. Quality screen: normal NRMSE<=5%,cosine>=0.995;outlier NRMSE<=10%,cosine>=0.98;max_abs reported without veto. 64warm each arm,8cycles A/B/B/A,64chains/arm in screen,128 in independent confirm;batch8 with final queue drain. Stable cycle if abs A and B drift<=3%;shape/mode qualifies with>=6stable cycles,median gain>=3%,quality passes. If any qualifies,confirm ALL formats/shapes/modes in fresh processes;selected cells must independently pass same gates. Keep all raw observations;no significance claim or resampling. Model requires independently confirmed eligible regime;model output token equality is not a precision acceptance criterion.Production source/config/executable untouched.
